lines.text: Did you know? Pos is Latin for put.
Quick quiz! Which means under plus put?

words.ex: Mozart composed his first music at the age of five.

publish.title: Pos root: compose, expose and suppose
publish.value: Pos comes from Latin "ponere" (to put, to place). Words: compose, expose and suppose. compose = com + pos; expose = ex + pos; suppose = sup + pos.
